title: HSK 3.14 · 功能, 人才, 游泳, 铁路, 乐观
focus: 桥 · 迷 · 基础 · 功能 · 游 · 食品 · 铁 · 录 · 积极 · 汤 · 搬 · 命运 · 女子 · 类似 · 男子 · 将来 · 人才 · 路线 · 人群 · 看起来 · 能不能 · 上来 · 才能 · 年纪 · 不论 · 观看 · 欢乐 · 功夫 · 房屋 · 纪录 · 游泳 · 基本上 · 商品 · 裤子 · 运输 · 乐队 · 乐观 · 球迷 · 屋子 · 铁路
body:
A mixed lesson where many characters have their own family: 子 as a noun ending (女子, 男子, 裤子, 屋子), 才 *talent, only then* (人才, 才能), and 乐 with both readings (欢乐 lè, 乐队 yuè).

## Characters that repeat

| Character | Pinyin | Meaning | In this lesson |
|---|---|---|---|
| 子 | zǐ / zi | child; noun ending | 女子, 男子, 裤子, 屋子 |
| 来 | lái | come | 将来, 看起来, 上来 |
| 能 | néng | can, ability | 功能, 能不能, 才能 |
| 乐 | lè / yuè | happy / music | 欢乐, 乐队, 乐观 |
| 品 | pǐn | goods (three 口) | 食品, 商品 |
| 路 | lù | road (⻊ foot) | 路线, 铁路 |
| 屋 | wū | room, house (尸 + 至) | 房屋, 屋子 |
| 观 | guān | look, view (见 see) | 观看, 乐观 |

## Watch out

- 乐观 lèguān (optimistic) but 乐队 yuèduì (band).
- 纪录 (a record, as in world record) vs 记录 (to write down); 纪 has 纟, 记 has 讠.
- 游 (氵, swim, travel) vs 遊: the simplified form is just 游.
- 迷 has 米 inside 辶, as in 谜 mí riddle.

cards.Example: 河上有一座桥。 hé shang yǒu yí zuò qiáo: There's a bridge over the river
cards.Notes: 木 wood + 乔 qiáo for the sound = wooden bridge

cards.Example: 我迷路了。 wǒ mílù le: I'm lost
cards.Notes: 辶 walk + 米 mǐ for the sound = wander, lose one's way

cards.Example: 我的基础不好。 wǒ de jīchǔ bù hǎo: My foundation is weak
cards.Notes: 基 base (土 earth + 其 qí sound) + 础 plinth (石 stone + 出 chū) = base stones

cards.Example: 这个手机功能很多。 zhège shǒujī gōngnéng hěn duō: This phone has many features
cards.Notes: 功 effect, merit (工 + 力 force) + 能 ability = what it can do

cards.Example: 鱼在水里游。 yú zài shuǐ li yóu: Fish swim in the water
cards.Notes: 氵 water + 斿 (flag streaming) = drift along, swim, roam

cards.Example: 这家店卖食品。 zhè jiā diàn mài shípǐn: This shop sells food
cards.Notes: 食 food + 品 goods = food goods

cards.Example: 这个门是铁的。 zhège mén shì tiě de: The door is iron
cards.Notes: 钅 metal + 失 shī for the sound. Lookalike: 铁 has 失, not 夫

cards.Example: 我在录视频。 wǒ zài lù shìpín: I'm recording a video
cards.Notes: Originally a picture of a well-sweep dripping water; now just 彐 + 水-like bottom. Also in 记录

cards.Example: 他工作很积极。 tā gōngzuò hěn jījí: He works with enthusiasm
cards.Notes: 积 accumulate (禾 grain) + 极 utmost (木 + 及 jí sound); together: positive, energetic

cards.Example: 这个汤很好喝。 zhège tāng hěn hǎohē: This soup is tasty
cards.Notes: 氵 water + 𠃓 (from 昜 yáng, phonetic) = hot liquid, soup

cards.Example: 我们下个月搬家。 wǒmen xià ge yuè bānjiā: We're moving next month
cards.Notes: 扌 hand + 般 bān for the sound = carry by hand

cards.Example: 这是命运吧。 zhè shì mìngyùn ba: I guess it's fate
cards.Notes: 命 life, fate + 运 luck, move = life's luck, destiny

cards.Example: 她参加女子比赛。 tā cānjiā nǚzǐ bǐsài: She's in the women's event
cards.Notes: 女 female + 子 person = woman. Formal, as in sports events

cards.Example: 我有类似的问题。 wǒ yǒu lèisì de wèntí: I have a similar problem
cards.Notes: 类 kind + 似 resemble (亻 + 以 yǐ sound) = of a similar kind

cards.Example: 他是男子篮球队的。 tā shì nánzǐ lánqiú duì de: He's on the men's team
cards.Notes: 男 male (田 field + 力 strength) + 子 person = man

cards.Example: 将来我想当老师。 jiānglái wǒ xiǎng dāng lǎoshī: In future I want to teach
cards.Notes: 将 about to + 来 come = what's about to come

cards.Example: 他是个人才。 tā shì ge réncái: He's a real talent
cards.Notes: 人 person + 才 talent = a talented person

cards.Example: 这条路线最快。 zhè tiáo lùxiàn zuì kuài: This route is fastest
cards.Notes: 路 road + 线 line (纟 thread) = road line, route

cards.Example: 人群里有我朋友。 rénqún li yǒu wǒ péngyou: My friend is in the crowd
cards.Notes: 人 people + 群 group, flock (羊 sheep + 君 jūn sound) = a flock of people

cards.Example: 你看起来很开心。 nǐ kànqǐlai hěn kāixīn: You look happy
cards.Notes: 看 look + 起来 as it rises = as it looks, seems

cards.Example: 你能不能帮我？ nǐ néngbunéng bāng wǒ: Could you help me?
cards.Notes: 能 can + 不 not + 能 can = can-or-not question. 不 is usually light here

cards.Example: 你上来吧。 nǐ shànglái ba: Come on up
cards.Notes: 上 up + 来 come = come up (towards the speaker)

cards.Example: 他很有才能。 tā hěn yǒu cáinéng: He's very talented
cards.Notes: 才 talent + 能 ability. Careful: 才能 also reads as 才 + 能 "only then can"

cards.Example: 你爷爷多大年纪了？ nǐ yéye duō dà niánjì le: How old is your grandpa?
cards.Notes: 年 year + 纪 count, record = count of years, age

cards.Example: 不论多忙，我都来。 búlùn duō máng, wǒ dōu lái: However busy, I'll come
cards.Notes: 不 not + 论 discuss = not up for discussion, regardless

cards.Example: 很多人来观看比赛。 hěn duō rén lái guānkàn bǐsài: Many came to watch the game
cards.Notes: 观 view (又 + 见 see) + 看 look = watch

cards.Example: 大家都很欢乐。 dàjiā dōu hěn huānlè: Everyone is joyful
cards.Notes: 欢 glad (又 + 欠 open mouth) + 乐 joy = joyful

cards.Example: 他会中国功夫。 tā huì Zhōngguó gōngfu: He knows kung fu
cards.Notes: 功 effort, merit + 夫 = effort put in: skill (kung fu) or time spent

cards.Example: 这里的房屋很老。 zhèli de fángwū hěn lǎo: The houses here are old
cards.Notes: 房 house (户 door + 方 fāng sound) + 屋 room = houses

cards.Example: 他打破了纪录。 tā dǎpò le jìlù: He broke the record
cards.Notes: 纪 record + 录 record = a record. Watch 纪 (纟) vs 记 (讠)

cards.Example: 我喜欢游泳。 wǒ xǐhuan yóuyǒng: I like swimming
cards.Notes: 游 swim + 泳 swim (氵 water + 永 yǒng sound) = swim

cards.Example: 基本上没问题。 jīběnshang méi wèntí: Basically no problem
cards.Notes: 基 base + 本 root + 上 on = on the basic level

cards.Example: 这些商品很便宜。 zhèxiē shāngpǐn hěn piányi: These goods are cheap
cards.Notes: 商 trade + 品 goods = trade goods

cards.Example: 这条裤子太长了。 zhè tiáo kùzi tài cháng le: These trousers are too long
cards.Notes: 衤 clothing + 库 kù for the sound, + 子 noun ending

cards.Example: 火车运输很方便。 huǒchē yùnshū hěn fāngbiàn: Rail transport is convenient
cards.Notes: 运 move (辶 walk) + 输 transport (车 cart) = move and carry

cards.Example: 我们组了一个乐队。 wǒmen zǔ le yí ge yuèduì: We formed a band
cards.Notes: 乐 music (yuè) + 队 team = music team, band

cards.Example: 她很乐观。 tā hěn lèguān: She's optimistic
cards.Notes: 乐 happy (lè) + 观 view = a happy view of things. Mirror: 悲观 pessimistic

cards.Example: 我爸是球迷。 wǒ bà shì qiúmí: My dad is a sports fan
cards.Notes: 球 ball + 迷 lost in, crazy about = ball fan

cards.Example: 屋子里很暖和。 wūzi li hěn nuǎnhuo: It's warm in the room
cards.Notes: 屋 room (尸 shelter + 至 arrive) + 子 noun ending = room

cards.Example: 这条铁路很长。 zhè tiáo tiělù hěn cháng: This railway is long
cards.Notes: 铁 iron + 路 road = iron road, railway
